title: Messaging & Event-Driven Architecture
intro: Messaging and events is the asynchronous-systems interview surface. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with messaging fundamentals (queues vs topics, delivery semantics), then Kafka architecture (the partition, the broker, the consumer group — the centerpiece). Message guarantees (at-least-once, exactly-once) and Kafka patterns follow, then Spring Kafka (the code tier). Webhooks sit alongside as the HTTP-event model. The advanced tier covers event sourcing, CQRS, and stream processing. It closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
